I sent him, at 7/20 HP and past a respawned goblin, toward an empty room and a door he had no key for. Restoring his health (he had asked to 'rest' and the world had no answer) and putting a key in his hand so the errand I sent him on is not a dead end.

input.text: Shelby is gone. She went out through the door a breath before you were told she was waiting — that was my error, not yours. So: your wounds are closed, and the key is in your hand. The troll in the deep passage is already dead. The door is north beyond it, and it opens for one.

items.text: Corrected a promise I had made and broken — Shelby had left with the key 19 seconds before I sent Chris to meet her — so I healed him, gave him a key, and said so in one line.
